summary: HenLog is the 30-second flock ledger for backyard chicken keepers. Collect the eggs, tap the big button, done — HenLog turns your daily count into weekly, monthly and yearly totals, lay-rate trends, and a simple answer to the question every chicken keeper asks: is this flock paying for itself?
features: One big button on the Today screen: +1 per egg, minus to correct, or type the total
Per-flock counting with a quick flock switcher
Today, last-7-days and lay-rate summary at a glance
Daily egg chart with a 7-day moving average
Lay rate (eggs per hen), daily average and best day
Spot molting, winter slowdowns and problems early
Flock and hen profiles: breed, joined date, photo and notes
